title: See why donor retention beats acquisition, in chat with Claude
description: Claude builds a five-year donor projection with sliders for retention and acquisition. Drag either one and the curve redraws, and it becomes clear fairly quickly why a modest retention bump does more than doubling the acquisition spend.
prompt: Everyone keeps telling me donor retention matters more than acquisition and I understand the argument but I don't really get it. Show me. Start with 100 donors and let me play with the numbers. I want to drag things and watch what happens.
prerequisites: Optional: your real retention rate and annual acquisition count
